text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oww... ouchhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe this, it hurts so much! 
Familiar, this is all your fault!
choice_data_list: Let's wrap it up for today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...! No way, you can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be a great witch just like 
Grandma! I don't have time to rest over 
something like this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: An order to my familiar: let me train!
choice_data_list: Let's try doing what we can.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: An order to my familiar: let me train!
choice_data_list: Let's try doing what we can.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why though?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your master is ordering you! Do something 
about this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While soothing a thrashing Sweep Tosho, I 
explained the danger of aggravating her 
injury and managed to convince her to rest 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine! Then I'm not moving an inch from 
here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar, bring me dinner! With dessert 
included!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And the TV and manga too! I'm seriously 
gonna live here now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho ended up completely sulking, 
which prolonged the time it took for her 
injury to heal.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Heheh, look at you catching on, familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's so much I have to do to become a 
great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's resume training right away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Owww!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That hurts, you familiar! Do something 
about this, aaaaah!!
choice_data_list: Let's take a break after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... But if I do that, I'll never be 
able to become like Grandma...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Sweep Tosho's impatience was 
somehow calmed down, she remained in a bad 
mood for a while afterwards……

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look, you can run just fine! 
Something like this is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Behold the power of a genius magical girl! 
Just you watch, I'll be just like Grandma 
in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sweep Tosho's injury fortunately 
turned out to be nothing serious.
